verdict.rationale: Check is a payroll API platform, so letting customers choose a data storage region is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence documents region selection or data residency controls. The self-hosted MCP server only controls where the MCP client runs, not where Check stores data, and IP restrictions on API keys are a separate security control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
